radius_desc: Distance from rotation center or length of the tether string
mass_desc: Mass of the body in circular motion
angularVelocity_desc: Rotational speed in radians per second
maxTension_desc: Breaking strength threshold of the tether string
maxTension_real: String snaps if tension exceeds threshold and object flies tangentially
stringStiffness_desc: Spring constant governing elastic elongation under centripetal load
stringStiffness_real: Path radius expands elastically proportional to centripetal force
dragCoeff_real: Tangential deceleration in the absence of driving motor torque

presets.highSpeed: High Speed with High Centripetal Force

formulas.speedExpl: Linear tangential velocity is directly proportional to angular speed and orbit radius.
formulas.centripetalAccExpl: Centripetal acceleration is directed toward the center and changes velocity vector direction.
formulas.centripetalForceExpl: The net inward force supplied by string tension keeping the object in orbit.
formulas.periodFreqExpl: Time required for one complete orbit (T) and number of orbits per second (f).

steps.step1Instr: Keeping angular velocity at 4 rad/s, increase radius from 1m to 3m and observe centripetal acceleration.
steps.step1Hint: Acceleration scales linearly with radius: a_c = ω² * r.
steps.step2Title: Step 2: Effect of Angular Velocity on Tension
steps.step2Instr: Double the angular velocity (from 4 to 8 rad/s) and note how the string tension changes.
steps.step2Hint: Due to quadratic dependence (F_c ∝ ω²), doubling ω quadruples the required centripetal force.
steps.step3Title: Step 3: Tether Rupture & Newton's First Law
steps.step3Instr: Select the 'Rope Rupture' preset and press Play to witness the string snap.
steps.step3Hint: Notice the mass does not fly outwards radially, but follows a straight line tangent to the circle.
